cycleConsumers.app/cockpit/panels.js: Cockpit cycle energy, requested/kept/delivered water, rate; fire and intake panels; instantaneous power and storage. Only missionReady opens the instruments.
cycleConsumers.app/cockpit/tables.js: Fire rates sum accepted missions at this fire; retired fleet statistics and flat table exclude inactive missions.
cycleConsumers.app/cockpit/gauges.js: Phase dial duration and remaining minutes use the cockpit's accepted plan.
cycleConsumers.app/cockpit/shipviz.js: Release animation leaves retained water aboard; rotor labels read the selected plan's instantaneous state.
cycleConsumers.app/dom.js: Cycle bar and phase minutes use the accepted cockpit mission.
cycleConsumers.app/worked.js: Worked quantities use workedFigures after selectServedPlan; requested capacity cards remain configured assumptions.
cycleConsumers.app/loop.js: Storage integration uses instantaneous power from accepted missions; inactive missions do not drain storage.
cycleConsumers.app/map/render.js: Map motion and release animation skip inactive missions and read stateAt for the selected plan.
cycleConsumers.app/bridge/viz3d.js: 3D host telemetry comes from the accepted cockpit mission's stateAt power ledger.
cycleConsumers.sim/state.js: Phase timing, altitude, airspeed, water, force and power come from drawAt of the accepted mission; map paths remain schematic.
cycleConsumers.sim/narrate.js: Cycle, energy, delivered/retained water and rate follow the accepted plan; inactive quantities are unavailable with their reason.
cycleConsumers.sim/energy-view.js: Favourable basis replays exactly the record plan's controls; an infeasible paired plan publishes no cycle energy.
cycleConsumers.sim/served-view.js: Worked quantities are accepted plan fields; inactive plans yield no numeric rows.
cycleConsumers.concept/index.html: Worked tiles and paragraph use the same selector and formatter; static ruled sentences have exact generated regions.
cycleConsumers.tools/fallback_dump.js: Static exercise rates and worked mission are accepted after exact-input audit; figures regenerate with gen_fallback.py.

otherSurfaces.index.html: Generated fallback and generated energy sentences; static configured fleet counts are capacity assumptions, not achieved delivery.
otherSurfaces.engineering/index.html: No served mission energy or delivery figure; structural-float verdict belongs to the existing ledger generator.
otherSurfaces.ship/: No cycle energy, delivery, endurance or fleet rate; structural specifications and float verdicts keep their existing generators.
otherSurfaces.cell/: No mission energy, delivery, endurance or fleet rate; independent material and structural assumptions remain labelled.
otherSurfaces.float/: Generated structural ledger analysis, not a flight-plan or mission-energy surface.
otherSurfaces.3d/physics/energy.js: Mission power graphs use host telemetry; the nitrogen-store ledger is a labelled full-tank equipment calculation, not a mission result.
otherSurfaces.3d/scenes/scenes.js: Illustrative trajectory minutes and relative energies are explicitly labelled inputs, not mission results.
otherSurfaces.model-lab/index.html: Actuator experiments have no mission-energy record and label mission energy unavailable; storage assumptions and illustrative trajectories remain separate.
otherSurfaces.concept/energy-analysis.html: Generated summaries of the payload-exchange study and omissions, under explicit analysis labels; sketch-cycle energy is not promoted to mission results.
